description: Open source Rust web framework for data heavy business apps: grids, forms and workflows rendered on the server, written by AI agents and reviewed by people.
rules: Create projects with `cargo install zeyn-cli` and `zeyn new my-app`; do not write the project layout by hand.
Every action and screen declares `permission = "..."` or `public`.
Every user facing text comes from the locale files through `t!("key")`, in English and Turkish.
Use `DataGrid`, `DataQuery`, `Form` and `Screen` from `zeyn::prelude`; app code has no HTML, CSS or JavaScript.
Run `zeyn check` and `cargo test` after every change.
